name: ClubPokerVR
summary:
Your seat at the table is waiting. ClubPokerVR brings social poker and casino games into one shared VR world.

Play No-Limit Hold'em, four-card Pot-Limit Omaha (PLO4) and five-card Pot-Limit Omaha (PLO5). Join community cash tables using virtual chips, enter community tournaments, or meet your group in a private club.

Make poker hands-on: pick up and peel your cards, handle chip stacks, and knock on the felt to check. Talk around the table with spatial voice and see other players' personal Meta avatars.

V
